csv_scope_of_work: Village of Schaumburg maybe seeking Preliminary Design for North Meacham Road (west side) between Zurich Way and I-90. This project will implement recommendations to improve the streetscape along the North Meacham Road corridor including installing multiuse paths, landscaping, pedestrian plazas, identifier signage, and enhanced crosswalks. The intent of this Request for Qualification is to enable the Village of Schaumburg's Department of Transportation to establish relationships with vendors for Meacham Road Corridor Streetscape - Stage III.
